import unittest, tempfile, pathlib, os, json
from unittest.mock import patch
import daemon
import mtproto_common as common
import mtproto_gateway as mt

class MTProtoGatewayTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.db=daemon.open_db({"db":str(pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)/"inbox.sqlite3")})
        mt.setup_outbox(self.db)
        self.c={"db":str(pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)/"inbox.sqlite3"),"chatid":71,"userid":71,
                "base":"http://127.0.0.1:17448","CURATOR_MANAGED_CHAT_ID":"tg-curator-owner",
                "CURATOR_REPOSITORY":"foto6/boss",
                "CURATOR_BRANCH":"agent/telegram-curator-authority-20261012",
                "CURATOR_EXPECTED_HEAD":"773b42f59018a2e55834b87275796486d686e4f6"}
    def tearDown(self):
        self.db.close()
        self.tmp.cleanup()
    def test_message_is_saved_only_once(self):
        mt.accept_message(self.db,self.c,41,"/task Проверить Bridge")
        mt.accept_message(self.db,self.c,41,"/task Проверить Bridge")
        self.assertEqual(self.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inbox").fetchone()[0],1)
        r=self.db.execute("SELECT body,state FROM inbox").fetchone()
        self.assertEqual(r["body"],"Проверить Bridge")
        self.assertEqual(r["state"],"RECEIVED")
    def test_receipt_outbox_deduplicated(self):
        mt.queue_reply(self.db,self.c,"OK",41)
        mt.queue_reply(self.db,self.c,"OK",41)
        self.assertEqual(self.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mtproto_outbox").fetchone()[0],1)
    def test_status_displays_native_message_id(self):
        mt.accept_message(self.db,self.c,22,"task")
        self.assertIn("#22: RECEIVED",mt.current_status(self.db))
    def test_delivery_callback_does_not_call_bot_api(self):
        mt.accept_message(self.db,self.c,77,"test")
        with patch.object(daemon,"notify") as forbidden:
            mt.queue_reply(self.db,self.c,"sent",77)
            forbidden.assert_not_called()
    def test_proxy_config_is_local_and_never_emits_secret(self):
        root=pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)/"TgWsProxy"
        root.mkdir()
        (root/"config.json").write_text(json.dumps({
          "host":"127.0.0.1","port":1443,"secret":"a"*32
        }),encoding="utf8")
        with patch.dict(os.environ,{"APPDATA":self.tmp.name}):
            host,port,secret=common.proxy_config()
        self.assertEqual((host,port),("127.0.0.1",1443))
        self.assertEqual(len(secret),32)
    def test_proxy_rejects_nonlocal_ip(self):
        root=pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)/"TgWsProxy";root.mkdir()
        (root/"config.json").write_text(json.dumps({
          "host":"198.51.100.1","port":1443,"secret":"a"*32
        }),encoding="utf8")
        with patch.dict(os.environ,{"APPDATA":self.tmp.name}):
            with self.assertRaises(common.MTSetupError):common.proxy_config()
    def test_bridge_binding_is_pinned(self):
        c=common.make_bridge_config({"chatid":71,"userid":71})
        self.assertEqual(c["CURATOR_MANAGED_CHAT_ID"],"tg-curator-owner")
        self.assertEqual(c["chatid"],71)
        self.assertEqual(c["CURATOR_BRANCH"],"agent/telegram-curator-authority-20261012")

if __name__=="__main__":unittest.main()
